title: Chairman Laura V. Swett's response to U.S. Senator Edward J. Markey's et al. 11/13/2025 letter re concerns of the impact of data center development on residential electric bills under RM26-4 et al.

documents.name: Sen. Markey-RM26-4-000 et al.pdf
documents.text:
February 4, 2026

The Honorable Edward J. Markey
The Honorable Chris Van Hollen
The Honorable Elizabeth Warren
The Honorable Peter Welch
The Honorable Raphael Warnock
The Honorable Richard Blumenthal
The Honorable Adam B. Schiff
U.S. Senate
Washington, D.C. 20515/20510

Dear Senators Markey, Van Hollen, Warren, Welch, Warnock, Blumenthal, and Schiff:

      Thank you for your November 13, 2025, letter alerting the Federal Energy Regulatory
Commission (Commission) of your concerns regarding the impact of data center
development on residential electric bills. Your comments are essential to ensure that the
Commission’s consideration of this matter is both responsive and accurate.

       In your letter, you highlight the impact of the rising demand for electricity for data
centers on ratepayers and urge the Commission to prioritize residential ratepayers in Docket
No. RM26-4-000. You also encourage the Commission to reject transmission-related filings
that do not properly address cost allocation, allow the cost of new transmission built to serve
data centers to be spread across the region, or allow large fossil fuel generators to jump the
interconnection queue. You express support for investigations into existing methods for
transmission cost allocation and standardized load forecasting and other practices relevant to
addressing data center demand growth. Because there are several contested proceedings
pending with regard to these issues, I cannot discuss the merits of these matters at this time.

        You have my commitment that we will continue to monitor this situation. I take
seriously the Commission’s obligation to ensure our actions are in the public interest and can
assure you that any decisions the Commission makes will be based upon a thorough and
careful review of the record.

      Your letter and this reply will be placed in the public file in Docket Nos. RM26-4-
000, EL25-49-000 and EL25-20-000. If I can be of further assistance in this or any other
Commission matter, please do not hesitate to contact me.

                                                           Sincerely,


                                                           Laura V. Swett
                                                           Chairman


                               888 First Street | Washington, DC 20426
